title: Amtrak reports core booking-flow accessibility defects remediated with one mobile exception
summary: Amtrak reports that all core booking-flow accessibility issues were remediated after audits and that all outstanding digital accessibility defects were closed except the mobile-app landscape requirement. Denominator: The operator's current digital accessibility defect inventory as described in the June 2026 progress report, with one named exception and no defect-level table.
